constructor.details: Sets up the adapter to forward gas-refund intent calls from the specified router to the executor.      The adapter is initialized with version 0.0 as per SemVer convention.      Note: The second parameter to AdapterBase is address(0) since this adapter does not use      a separate arbiter - the executor handles validation internally.

params.executor: The address of the standalone intent executor contract
params.router: The address of the router contract that will call this adapter

handleFill_intentExecutor_executeMultich.custom:security: Gas refund terms must be included in the user's signature to prevent manipulation
handleFill_intentExecutor_executeMultich.details: This function executes multichain operations and settles gas refund to the relayer.      The gas refund recipient is extracted from the relayer context, which must contain      a 20-byte address. The user must have signed the gas refund terms in their signature.

params.gasRefund: The gas refund terms (token and amount) authorized by the user
params.ops: The MultiChainOps struct containing account, operations, nonce, and signature

returns._0: bytes4 The function selector to confirm successful handling

handleFill_intentExecutor_executeSinglec.custom:security: Gas refund terms must be included in the user's signature to prevent manipulation
handleFill_intentExecutor_executeSinglec.details: This function executes single-chain operations and settles gas refund to the relayer.      The gas refund recipient is extracted from the relayer context, which must contain      a 20-byte address. The user must have signed the gas refund terms in their signature.

params.gasRefund: The gas refund terms (token and amount) authorized by the user
params.ops: The SingleChainOps struct containing account, operations, nonce, and signature

returns._0: bytes4 The function selector to confirm successful handling

settlementLayerSpender().details: Adapters must override this function to specify the correct spender address

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Implements ERC-165 interface detection to declare support for the gas refund      intent execution handlers plus any interfaces supported by the parent AdapterBase.      This allows the router and other contracts to query supported functionality.

params.selector: The 4-byte interface selector to check for support

returns.supported: True if the selector is supported by this contract, false otherwise Supported selectors: - handleFill_intentExecutor_executeMultichainOps_gasRefund: Multichain execution with gas refund - handleFill_intentExecutor_executeSinglechainOps_gasRefund: Single-chain execution with gas refund - Any selectors supported by AdapterBase (isAdapter, etc.)

ARBITER().notice: The Arbiter contract address responsible for validating settlements

_ROUTER().notice: The Router contract address that this adapter is designed to work with

constructor.notice: Initializes the IntentExecutorAdapterGasRefund with router and executor addresses

handleFill_intentExecutor_executeMultich.notice: Handles multichain intent execution with gas refund

handleFill_intentExecutor_executeSinglec.notice: Handles single-chain intent execution with gas refund

settlementLayerSpender().notice: Returns the address authorized to spend tokens for settlement

supportsInterface(bytes4).notice: Checks if this contract supports a given interface selector
